messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — Heliogenix (trial account) asked to onboard a new 13B clinical summarizer for inpatient progress notes. They say PHI is in scope and they'd like HSM/KMS for keys. Need guidance on safety evals + deployment mode (Dedicated vs Private). :eyes:
Liam Chen: Got it. Do we have the model artifact format (huggingface/ggml/torchscript) and whether they want quantized weights? That affects recommendation.
Maya Patel: Customer's SE uploaded a tarball (we can request S3 link). They mentioned a "gguf" export and want 8-bit quant. Unsure about licensing — asking if we can accept custom model on Private.
Arjun Singh: For trial accounts with PHI I'd strongly suggest Private (customer-managed network) + HSM. Dedicated could work but doesn't separate key custody. Also flag: renewal risk if we can't meet HSM requirement quickly.
Nora Alvarez: Security checklist: need dataflow diagram, required regions, data retention policy, and whether inference inputs contain direct identifiers. We'll need to validate encryption-at-rest and KMS integration. Ask customer to fill our PHI intake form. :clipboard:
Maya Patel: I'll ping them for the S3 link and have them fill the intake form. What's the standard eval plan for PHI summarizers?
Liam Chen: Typical plan: 1) safety regression on curated PHI prompts, 2) red-team prompts to check hallucination on identifiers, 3) token-level QA on redaction behavior, 4) latency/cost baseline on a 1k request sample. We can run the eval on Dedicated infra if customer can't do Private yet.
Liam Chen: Example quick eval command we run:
```bash
# run eval harness
python eval_harness.py --model s3://heliogenix/gguf.tar.gz --prompts phiprompts.json --out results.json --quant 8
```
Maya Patel: Nice. Customer also asked for a canary rollout and a rollback plan. They want this in two weeks for a pilot. Feasible? :calendar:
Arjun Singh: Two weeks is tight but doable for a pilot if they provide artifacts + intake form today. We'll need SE + Security review in the next 48 hours. Ops: estimate for Private deploy prep?
Liam Chen: For Private + HSM: infra setup 3-5 business days (if we have capacity), HSM integration 1-2 days with their KMS team, safety evals ~2-4 days depending on failures. So pilot in 10 business days is possible.
Nora Alvarez: Also need legal to confirm license allows hosting (some gguf exports are fine, some not). I'll loop in legal after intake.
ops-bot: Automated checklist created -> https://redwood.internal/checklists/ONBOARD-230112 (fill PHI form, upload model S3, assign SE, schedule security review). :white_check_mark:
Maya Patel: Action items: 1) I'll send S3 + intake link to Heliogenix now. 2) Liam to prepare eval harness + canary playbook. 3) Nora to schedule security review. 4) Arjun to flag renewal risk and pricing for Private/HSM pilot. Anyone want to add?
Arjun Singh: Please flag renewal risk in CRM — trial ends in 30 days, high risk if pilot blocked by HSM/legal. I'll draft pricing for the pilot and share by EOD.
Liam Chen: I'll stand up an eval instance and drop an access link in this thread once S3 is available. Plan to include automated redaction tests.
Nora Alvarez: Once intake form is in, I'll run a quick checklist and send required artifacts list. If they're okay, I'll approve security for pilot.
Maya Patel: Thanks — I'll update the customer and confirm S3 by end of day. Scheduling: recommend a sync Tue 09:30 PT for kickoff. :thumbsup:
